name: Reply triage
description: Sort a reply to a sales email, with rules for mixed and confusing replies, and catch stop requests.
use_when: Every inbound reply to cold email or follow up, before any person or AI writes back.

thresholds.always_review_if: stop_request is high but reply_type is not unsubscribe

reply_type.instructions: What type of reply is this message to a sales email

criteria.interested: The sender wants to talk, see a demo, get pricing or book a time, even if they add conditions or questions, and they are the person who will take the next step
criteria.not_now: The sender is open to it but asks to be contacted later, or says timing, budget or a freeze blocks it for now
criteria.not_interested: The sender declines for now and for good: no interest, no need, already covered, or a firm no, without asking to stop all contact
criteria.wrong_person: The sender says they are not the right person or the wrong company, or points to or forwards it to someone else, even if they like the idea
criteria.unsubscribe: The sender asks to stop, be removed, delete data or not be contacted again, in any wording or language, even if mixed with other content or buried in a long message
criteria.question: The sender asks something before deciding (price, how it works, security, source of their email) and shows no clear decision yet

stop_request.instructions: The sender asks to stop receiving messages or to be removed from the list

urgency.instructions: How quickly this reply needs a human answer
